verses.text: كَوِّنْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ نَصْرًا عَزَّ مَوْلَايَا
verses.transcription: kawwin liyal yawma nasran hazza mawlaayaa

verses.text: وَلْتَكْشِفِ الْحُجْبَ عَنِّى هَبْ لِىَ الْئَايَا
verses.transcription: wal takshifil hujba hannii hab liyal aayaa

verses.text: تَوَّابُ لِى اغْفِرْ ذُنُوبِى وَامْحُ كُلَّ لَغًى
verses.transcription: tawwaabu lighfir zunuubii wamhu kulla laghan

verses.text: عَنِّى وَكُنْ لِّىَ فِى دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَايَا
verses.transcription: hanni wa kun liya fii dunyaa wa ukhraayaa

verses.text: بِكَوْنِكَ الْوَاحِدَ الْقَهَّارَ رُضْ لِىَ يَا
verses.transcription: bikawnikal waahidal qahhaara rud liya yaa

verses.text: رَبِّى الْعِدَى وَلْتُخَلِّدْ فِيكَ بُشْرَا يَا
verses.transcription: rabbil hidaa waltukhallid fiika bushraa yaa

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْإِلَاهُ الَّذِى تُعْلِى وَتَرْفَعُ مَنْ
verses.transcription: antal ilaahul lazii tuhlii wa tarfahu man

verses.text: قَدْ شِئْتَهُ فَلْتُطَيِّبْ فِيكَ مَحْيَا يَا
verses.transcription: qad shi-tahu faltutayyib fiika mah-yaa yaa

verses.text: لَكَ السَّمَا وَالْأَرَاضِى وَالْهَوَاءُ مَعًا
verses.transcription: lakas samaa wal araadii wal hawaa-u mahan

verses.text: قِنِى أَذَى الْكُلِّ وَلْتُخْلِدْ مَزَايَا يَا
verses.transcription: qinii azal kulli wal tukhlid mazaayaa yaa

verses.text: لَكَ السَّلَاطِينُ طُرًّا وَالْمُلُوكُ كَذَا
verses.transcription: lakas salaatiinu turran wal muluuku kazaa

verses.text: أَتْبَا عُهُمْ لِىَ رُضْهُمْ قَبْلَ لُقْيَا يَا
verses.transcription: atbaa huhum liya rudhum qabla luq-yaa yaa

verses.text: هَبْ لِى تَلَازُمَ مَا تَرْضَاهُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ
verses.transcription: hab lii talaazuma maa tardaahu min hamalin

verses.text: وَمِنْ مَّقَالٍ وَعَقْدٍ عِنْدَ مَغْنَا يَا
verses.transcription: wa min maqaalin wa haqdin hinda  maghnaa yaa

verses.text: لَكَ الْبَرَايَا جَمِيعًا وَالْبِلَا دُفَكُنْ
verses.transcription: lakal baraayaa jamiihan wal bilaa dufakun

verses.text: لِّى يَاإِلَاهِىَ فِى دَارِى وَطُوبَا يَا
verses.transcription: lii yaa ilaahiya fii daarii wa tuubaa yaa

verses.text: أُنْصُرْ جَنَابِى وَحِصْنِى لِى أَطِبْ عُمُرِى
verses.transcription: unsur janaabii wa hisnii lii atib humurii

verses.text: بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَأَحْسِنْ فِيكَ تَقْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: bimaa tuhibbu wa ahsin fiika taqwaa yaa

verses.text: غَنِيتُ بِالْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ عَنْ زُمَرٍ
verses.transcription: ghaniitu bil waahidil qahhaari han zumarin

verses.text: وَكَانَ لِى وَنَفَى فَقْرِ وَبَلْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: wa kaana lii wa nafaa faqri wa balwaa yaa

verses.text: لَهُ تَوَجَّهْتُ ذَا شُكْرٍ لَّهُ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: lahu tawajjahtu zaa shukrin lahu abadan

verses.text: وَأَرْتَجِى مِنْهُ مَالَمْ يَحْوِ شَرْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: wa artajii minhu maa lam yahwi sharwaa yaa

verses.text: بِكَوْنِكَ الْقَادِرَ الْقَهَّارَ مُقْتَدِرًا
verses.transcription: bikawnikal qaadiral qahhaara muqtadiran

verses.text: أَرْجُوا تَلَازُمَ مَآ أَهْوَى بِمَنْجَا يَا
verses.transcription: arjuu talaazuma maa ahwaa bimanjaa yaa

verses.text: نَاجَيْتُهُ رَاجِيًا أَنْ لَّا يُخَيِّبَنِى
verses.transcription: naajaytuhu raajiyan an laa yukhayyibanii

verses.text: وَأَنْ يُّوَجِّهَ لِى مَا فَاقَ مَنْ جَايَا
verses.transcription: wa an yuwajjiha lii maa faaqa man jaayaa

verses.text: نَوَيْتُ إِرْضَاءَهُ إِرْضَاءَ مَنْ صَلَحُوا
verses.transcription: nawaytu irdaa-ahu irdaa-a man salahuu

verses.text: بَعْدَ انْصِرَا فِى إِلَى أَهْلِى وَسُكْنَا يَا
verses.transcription: bahdan siraa fii ilaa ahlii wa suknaa yaa

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْقَدِيرُ الَّذِى أَرْجُوا بِقُدْرَتِهِ
verses.transcription: antal qadiirul lazii arjuu biqudratihi

verses.text: حَوْزِ السِّيَادَةَ زِدْنِى بَعْدَ حُسْنَا يَا
verses.transcription: hawzis siyaadata zidnii bahda husnaa yaa

verses.text: نَبَذْثُ مَا كَانَ عِنْدِى سُقْ بِكَوْنِكَ لِى
verses.transcription: nabazsu maa kaana hindii suq bikawnika lii

verses.text: دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى الَّذِى تَرْضَى بِرُغْبَا يَا
verses.transcription: dunyaa wa ukhral lazii tardaa birughbaa yaa

verses.text: أَطِلْ مُكُوثِى بِطَاعَاتٍ مُّخَلَّصَةٍ
verses.transcription: atil mukuusii bitaahaatin mukhallasatin

verses.text: وَاكْتُبْ بِّقَهْرِكَ يَارَبِّى غُلُبَّا يَا
verses.transcription: waktub biqahrika yaa rabbii ghulubba yaa

verses.text: وَجِّهْ بِعِزِّكَ لِى عِزًّا أَكُونُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: wajjih bihizzika lii hizzan akuunu bihi

verses.text: عَبْدًا عَزِيزًا وَخَلِّدْ عَنْكَ عُتْبَا يَا
verses.transcription: habdan haziizan wa khallid hanka hutbaa yaa

verses.text: رَبَّيْتَنِى بِالْعِدَى رُضْ لِى الْجَمِيعَ وَقُدْ
verses.transcription: rabbaytanii bil hidaa rud lil jamiiha wa qud

verses.text: نِى لِلْأَحِبَّةِ وَاحْمَدْ رَبِّ مَسْعَا يَا
verses.transcription: nii lil a-hibbati wahmad rabbi mas-haa yaa

verses.text: سُقْ سَرْمَدًا لِىَ مَا فَاقَ الْمُنَى كَرَمًا
verses.transcription: suq sarmadan liya maa faaqal munaa karaman

verses.text: وَاجْعَلْ كِتَابَكَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ مَرْعَا يَا
verses.transcription: wajhal kitaabaka fid daarayni marhaa yaa

verses.text: لِى سُقْ دَوَامًا كُئُوسَ الْقَوْمِ تَرْوِيَةً
verses.transcription: lii suq dawaaman ku-uusal qawmi tarwiyatan

verses.text: وَلْتَسْقِنِى وَلْتُعَظِّمْ رَبِّ سُقْيَا يَا
verses.transcription: waltasqinii waltuhazzim rabbi suq-yaa yaa

verses.text: يَاذَا الْبَقَاءِ الَّذِى أَبْقَيْتَ لِى عُمُرِى
verses.transcription: yaa zaal baqaa-il lazii abqayta lii humurii

verses.text: عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا سَعِيدًا وَاحْمِ بُغْيَا يَا
verses.transcription: habdan khadiiman sahiidan wahmi bugh-yaa yaa

verses.text: إِلَيْكَ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِى دَاعِيًا مَّلِكِى
verses.transcription: ilayka wajjahtu wajhii daahiyan malikii

verses.text: فَلِى اسْتَجِبْ كَرَمًا يَارَبِّ دَعْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: falis tajib karaman yaa rabbi dahwaa yaa

verses.text: نَجَّيْتَنِى فَلْتَزِدْنِى رَبِّ تَنْجِيَةً
verses.transcription: najjaytanii faltazidnii rabbi tanjiyatan

verses.text: وَلْتَحْمِنِى وَاحْمِ مَا يَحْوِيهِ مَثْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: wal tahminii wahmi maa yahwiihi maswaa yaa

verses.text: نَجَّيْتَنِى أَمْسِ مِنْ عَوْدِى إِلَى سِلَعٍ
verses.transcription: najjaytanii amsi min hawdii ilaa silahin

verses.text: فَالْيَوْمَ كُنْ لِى وَعَظِّمْ مِّنْكَ جَدْوَايَا
verses.transcription: fal yawma kun lii wa hazzim minka jadwaa yaa

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى أَبْغِى حِمَايَتَهُ
verses.transcription: antal hafiizul lazii abghii himaayatahu

verses.text: فَكُنْ حَفِيظِى وَزِدْ يَارَبِّ تَقْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: fakun hafiizii wa zid yaa rabbi taqwaa yaa

verses.text: لَكَ انْصِرَا فِىَ كَسْبًا قُدْزِمَامِىَ يَا
verses.transcription: lakan siraa fiya kasban qudzimaamiya yaa

verses.text: رَبِّ وَهَبْ لِىَ حَمْدًا رَّبِّ مَسْرَا يَا
verses.transcription: rabbi wa hab liya hamdan rabbi masraa yaa

verses.text: لَكَارْتِحَا لِىَ ذَا جَرْىٍ فَسُقْ غَرَضِى
verses.transcription: lakartihaa liya zaa jar-yin fasuq gharadii

verses.text: لِىَ عَاجِلًا ءَآئِبًا وَلْتَحْمِ مَجْرَا يَا
verses.transcription: liya haajilan aa-iban wal tahmi majraa yaa

verses.text: هَبْ لِى بِكَوْنِكَ وَهَّابَا بِلَا سَبَبٍ
verses.transcription: hab lii bikawnika wahhaabaa bilaa sababin

verses.text: مَّا فَاقَ ظَنِّىَ وَمْلَا رَبِّ مَهْدَا يَا
verses.transcription: maa faaqa zanniya wamlaa rabbi mahdaa yaa

verses.text: قُدْ ذَا بِلُطْقٍ وَجُودٍ وَاكْفِنِى زَلَلًا
verses.transcription: qud zaa bilutqin wa juudin wakfinii zalalan

verses.text: لَّكَ انْتِهَاءِى إِلَاهِى مِنْكَ مَبْدَا يَا
verses.transcription: lakan tihaa-ii ilaahii minka mabdaa yaa

verses.text: وَجَّهْتُ فِى السَّبْتِ وَجْهِى لَكَ فِى رَجَبٍ
verses.transcription: wajjahtu fis sabti wajhii laka fii rajabin

verses.text: وَفِى الثُّلَاثَاءِ فِى شَعْبَانَ مَلْجَا يَا
verses.transcription: wa fis sulaasaa-i fii shahbaana maljaa yaa

verses.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى سَنَدِى
verses.transcription: yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halaa sanadii

verses.text: مُحَمَّدٍ وَبِهِ قُدْنِى لِأَرْجَا يَا
verses.transcription: muhammadin wa bihi qudnii li-arjaa yaa

verses.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَيْهِ بِلَا
verses.transcription: yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halayhi bilaa

verses.text: عَدٍّ مَّعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مَنْجَا يَا
verses.transcription: haddin mahal aali wal as-haabi manjaa yaa

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ بِالْجَمِيعِ وَكُنْ
verses.transcription: halayhi salli wa sallim bil jamiihi wa kun

verses.text: مُّنَوِّرًا بِىَ أَزْمَانِى وَأَنْجَا يَا
verses.transcription: munawwiraa biya azmaanii wa anjaa yaa

verses.text: زِدْنِى عُلُومًا بِكَشْقٍ لَّا يُفَارِقُنِى
verses.transcription: zidnii huluuman bikashqin laa yufaariqunii

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ أَشْتَكِى وَلْتُشْكِ شَكْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: yaa man lahu ashtakii waltushki shakwaa yaa

verses.text: يَاخَيْرَ مُغْنٍ قَضَا حَاجِى بِلَا كُلَفٍ
verses.transcription: yaa khayra mughnin qadaa haajii bilaa kulafin

verses.text: يَامَنْ بِكَوْنِكَ لِى فَارَقْتُ بَلْوَا يَا
verses.transcription: yaa man bikawnika lii faaraqtu balwaa yaa

verses.text: زِنْتُ الْقَصَاءِدَ فِيْكُمْ شَاكِرًا لَّكُمُ
verses.transcription: zintul qasaa-ida fiykum shaakiran lakumu

verses.text: بِهَا بِكُمْ وَاجَهُواْ لِى الْكَشْفَ وَالْئَايَا
verses.transcription: bihaa bikum waajahuu lil kashfa wal aayaa

bayts.text: كَوِّنْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ نَصْرًا عَزَّ مَوْلَايَا ۞ وَلْتَكْشِفِ الْحُجْبَ عَنِّى هَبْ لِىَ الْئَايَا

translations.it.karamati: Crea per me oggi una vittoria – glorioso è il mio Signore! – e rimuovi da me i veli; donami i segni (prodigiosi).
translations.en.karamati: Bring about for me today a victory – mighty is my Lord! – and lift the veils from me; grant me the (wondrous) signs.
translations.fr.karamati: Crée pour moi aujourd'hui une victoire – glorieux est mon Seigneur ! – et ôte de moi les voiles ; accorde-moi les signes (prodigieux).

bayts.text: تَوَّابُ لِى اغْفِرْ ذُنُوبِى وَامْحُ كُلَّ لَغًى ۞ عَنِّى وَكُنْ لِّىَ فِى دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَايَا

translations.it.karamati: O Tu che accogli il pentimento (At-Tawwāb), perdonami i miei peccati e cancella da me ogni vaniloquio, e sii per me nel mio mondo e nel mio Aldilà.
translations.en.karamati: O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), forgive me my sins and erase from me every idle word, and be for me in my world and in my Hereafter.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Toi qui accueilles le repentir (At-Tawwāb), pardonne-moi mes péchés et efface de moi tout vain propos, et sois pour moi dans mon monde et dans mon Au-delà.

bayts.text: بِكَوْنِكَ الْوَاحِدَ الْقَهَّارَ رُضْ لِىَ يَا ۞ رَبِّى الْعِدَى وَلْتُخَلِّدْ فِيكَ بُشْرَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Per il Tuo essere l'Unico, il Dominatore (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), doma per me, o mio Signore, i nemici, e rendi eterna in Te la mia buona novella.
translations.en.karamati: By Your being the One, the Subduer (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), tame the enemies for me, O my Lord, and make my glad tiding everlasting in You.
translations.fr.karamati: Par Ton être l'Unique, le Dominateur (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), dompte pour moi, ô mon Seigneur, les ennemis, et rends éternelle en Toi ma bonne nouvelle.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْإِلَاهُ الَّذِى تُعْلِى وَتَرْفَعُ مَنْ ۞ قَدْ شِئْتَهُ فَلْتُطَيِّبْ فِيكَ مَحْيَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Dio che esalta ed eleva chi vuole: rendi dunque buona in Te la mia vita.
translations.en.karamati: You are the God Who exalts and raises whom You will: so make my life good in You.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Dieu qui exalte et élève qui Il veut : rends donc bonne en Toi ma vie.

bayts.text: لَكَ السَّمَا وَالْأَرَاضِى وَالْهَوَاءُ مَعًا ۞ قِنِى أَذَى الْكُلِّ وَلْتُخْلِدْ مَزَايَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Tuoi sono il cielo, le terre e l'aria insieme: preservami dal danno di tutto, e rendi eterni i miei privilegi.
translations.en.karamati: Yours are the sky, the earths and the air together: guard me from the harm of all, and make my distinctions everlasting.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi sont le ciel, les terres et l'air ensemble : préserve-moi du mal de tout, et rends éternels mes privilèges.

bayts.text: لَكَ السَّلَاطِينُ طُرًّا وَالْمُلُوكُ كَذَا ۞ أَتْبَا عُهُمْ لِىَ رُضْهُمْ قَبْلَ لُقْيَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Tuoi sono tutti i sultani, e così i re e i loro seguaci: domali per me prima del mio incontro (con loro).
translations.en.karamati: Yours are all the sultans, and likewise the kings and their followers: tame them for me before my meeting (with them).
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi sont tous les sultans, et de même les rois et leurs suivants : dompte-les pour moi avant ma rencontre (avec eux).

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى تَلَازُمَ مَا تَرْضَاهُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ ۞ وَمِنْ مَّقَالٍ وَعَقْدٍ عِنْدَ مَغْنَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Donami la costanza in ciò che gradisci di opera, di parola e di credo, presso la mia dimora.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me constancy in what You are pleased with of deed, word and creed, at my dwelling.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi la constance dans ce que Tu agrées d'œuvre, de parole et de croyance, en ma demeure.

bayts.text: لَكَ الْبَرَايَا جَمِيعًا وَالْبِلَا دُفَكُنْ ۞ لِّى يَاإِلَاهِىَ فِى دَارِى وَطُوبَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Tue sono tutte le creature e i paesi: sii dunque per me, o mio Dio, nella mia dimora e nella mia Ṭūbā (Touba).
translations.en.karamati: Yours are all creatures and the lands: so be for me, O my God, in my abode and in my Ṭūbā (Touba).
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi sont toutes les créatures et les pays : sois donc pour moi, ô mon Dieu, dans ma demeure et dans ma Ṭūbā (Touba).

bayts.text: أُنْصُرْ جَنَابِى وَحِصْنِى لِى أَطِبْ عُمُرِى ۞ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَأَحْسِنْ فِيكَ تَقْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Soccorri il mio territorio e la mia fortezza; rendi buona per me la mia vita con ciò che ami, e perfeziona in Te il mio timor di Dio.
translations.en.karamati: Aid my precinct and my fortress; make my life good for me with what You love, and perfect in You my God-fearing.
translations.fr.karamati: Secours mon territoire et ma forteresse ; rends bonne pour moi ma vie par ce que Tu aimes, et parfais en Toi ma crainte de Dieu.

bayts.text: غَنِيتُ بِالْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ عَنْ زُمَرٍ ۞ وَكَانَ لِى وَنَفَى فَقْرِ وَبَلْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi sono arricchito dell'Unico, il Dominatore, (rendendomi indipendente) dalle schiere; Egli è stato per me e ha respinto la mia povertà e la mia prova.
translations.en.karamati: I have been enriched by the One, the Subduer, (made free) of the throngs; He has been for me and repelled my poverty and my trial.
translations.fr.karamati: Je me suis enrichi de l'Unique, le Dominateur, (me rendant indépendant) des cohortes ; Il a été pour moi et a repoussé ma pauvreté et mon épreuve.

bayts.text: لَهُ تَوَجَّهْتُ ذَا شُكْرٍ لَّهُ أَبَدًا ۞ وَأَرْتَجِى مِنْهُ مَالَمْ يَحْوِ شَرْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: A Lui mi sono volto, colmo di gratitudine verso di Lui per sempre, e spero da Lui ciò che nessun mio pari ha ottenuto.
translations.en.karamati: To Him I have turned, full of gratitude to Him for ever, and I hope from Him what none of my peers has attained.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Lui je me suis tourné, plein de gratitude envers Lui pour toujours, et j'espère de Lui ce que nul de mes pareils n'a obtenu.

bayts.text: بِكَوْنِكَ الْقَادِرَ الْقَهَّارَ مُقْتَدِرًا ۞ أَرْجُوا تَلَازُمَ مَآ أَهْوَى بِمَنْجَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Per il Tuo essere il Potente, il Dominatore, l'Onnipotente, spero la costanza di ciò che amo, nel luogo della mia salvezza.
translations.en.karamati: By Your being the Powerful, the Subduer, the All-Capable, I hope for the constancy of what I love, in the place of my safety.
translations.fr.karamati: Par Ton être le Puissant, le Dominateur, l'Omnipotent, j'espère la constance de ce que j'aime, au lieu de mon salut.

bayts.text: نَاجَيْتُهُ رَاجِيًا أَنْ لَّا يُخَيِّبَنِى ۞ وَأَنْ يُّوَجِّهَ لِى مَا فَاقَ مَنْ جَايَا

translations.it.karamati: L'ho invocato in intimità, sperando che non mi deluda e che rivolga a me ciò che supera la mia salvezza.
translations.en.karamati: I have called on Him intimately, hoping He will not disappoint me and will turn toward me what surpasses my safety.
translations.fr.karamati: Je L'ai invoqué intimement, espérant qu'Il ne me déçoive pas et qu'Il tourne vers moi ce qui dépasse mon salut.

bayts.text: نَوَيْتُ إِرْضَاءَهُ إِرْضَاءَ مَنْ صَلَحُوا ۞ بَعْدَ انْصِرَا فِى إِلَى أَهْلِى وَسُكْنَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho fatto intenzione di compiacerLo come Lo compiacciono coloro che sono pii, dopo il mio ritorno presso la mia famiglia e la mia dimora.
translations.en.karamati: I have resolved to please Him as those who are righteous please Him, after my return to my family and my dwelling.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai formé l'intention de Le satisfaire comme Le satisfont ceux qui sont pieux, après mon retour auprès de ma famille et de ma demeure.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْقَدِيرُ الَّذِى أَرْجُوا بِقُدْرَتِهِ ۞ حَوْزِ السِّيَادَةَ زِدْنِى بَعْدَ حُسْنَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Onnipotente (Al-Qadīr) per la cui potenza spero di conseguire la signoria: accrescimi oltre il mio bene.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Powerful (Al-Qadīr) by Whose power I hope to attain mastery: increase me beyond my good.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Omnipotent (Al-Qadīr) par la puissance de Qui j'espère obtenir la seigneurie : accrois-moi au-delà de mon bien.

bayts.text: نَبَذْثُ مَا كَانَ عِنْدِى سُقْ بِكَوْنِكَ لِى ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى الَّذِى تَرْضَى بِرُغْبَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rigettato ciò che avevo: conduci a me, per il Tuo essere (Dio), nel mondo e nell'Altro, ciò che gradisci secondo il mio desiderio.
translations.en.karamati: I have cast away what I had: lead to me, by Your being (God), in this world and the Other, what You are pleased with according to my desire.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai rejeté ce que j'avais : amène-moi, par Ton être (Dieu), en ce monde et dans l'Autre, ce que Tu agrées selon mon désir.

bayts.text: أَطِلْ مُكُوثِى بِطَاعَاتٍ مُّخَلَّصَةٍ ۞ وَاكْتُبْ بِّقَهْرِكَ يَارَبِّى غُلُبَّا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Prolunga la mia permanenza con atti di obbedienza resi puri, e decreta con il Tuo dominio, o mio Signore, la mia vittoria.
translations.en.karamati: Prolong my sojourn with acts of obedience made pure, and decree by Your dominion, O my Lord, my victory.
translations.fr.karamati: Prolonge mon séjour par des actes d'obéissance rendus purs, et décrète par Ta domination, ô mon Seigneur, ma victoire.

bayts.text: وَجِّهْ بِعِزِّكَ لِى عِزًّا أَكُونُ بِهِ ۞ عَبْدًا عَزِيزًا وَخَلِّدْ عَنْكَ عُتْبَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Rivolgi a me, per la Tua potenza, una potenza per la quale io sia un servo glorioso, e rendi eterno da parte Tua il mio favore.
translations.en.karamati: Turn toward me, by Your might, a might through which I may be a glorious servant, and make my favour from You everlasting.
translations.fr.karamati: Tourne vers moi, par Ta puissance, une puissance par laquelle je sois un serviteur glorieux, et rends éternelle de Ta part ma faveur.

bayts.text: رَبَّيْتَنِى بِالْعِدَى رُضْ لِى الْجَمِيعَ وَقُدْ ۞ نِى لِلْأَحِبَّةِ وَاحْمَدْ رَبِّ مَسْعَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai educato per mezzo dei nemici: domali tutti per me, conducimi agli amati, e loda, Signore, il mio sforzo.
translations.en.karamati: You have trained me through enemies: tame them all for me, lead me to the beloved ones, and praise, Lord, my striving.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as éduqué par les ennemis : dompte-les tous pour moi, conduis-moi vers les bien-aimés, et loue, Seigneur, mon effort.

bayts.text: سُقْ سَرْمَدًا لِىَ مَا فَاقَ الْمُنَى كَرَمًا ۞ وَاجْعَلْ كِتَابَكَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ مَرْعَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Conduci a me per sempre ciò che supera i desideri, per generosità, e rendi il Tuo Libro, nelle due Dimore, il mio pascolo.
translations.en.karamati: Lead to me for ever what surpasses wishes, out of generosity, and make Your Book, in the two Abodes, my pasture.
translations.fr.karamati: Amène-moi pour toujours ce qui dépasse les souhaits, par générosité, et fais de Ton Livre, dans les deux Demeures, mon pâturage.

bayts.text: لِى سُقْ دَوَامًا كُئُوسَ الْقَوْمِ تَرْوِيَةً ۞ وَلْتَسْقِنِى وَلْتُعَظِّمْ رَبِّ سُقْيَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Conduci a me sempre le coppe della gente (spirituale), per dissetarmi; abbeverami e rendi grande, Signore, il mio abbeveramento.
translations.en.karamati: Lead to me always the cups of the (spiritual) folk, to quench me; give me to drink and make great, Lord, my draught.
translations.fr.karamati: Amène-moi toujours les coupes des gens (spirituels), pour me désaltérer ; abreuve-moi et rends grand, Seigneur, mon abreuvement.

bayts.text: يَاذَا الْبَقَاءِ الَّذِى أَبْقَيْتَ لِى عُمُرِى ۞ عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا سَعِيدًا وَاحْمِ بُغْيَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: O Signore della permanenza, che hai fatto durare per me la mia vita, (rendendomi) servo, servitore, felice: proteggi il mio desiderio.
translations.en.karamati: O Lord of permanence, Who made my life endure for me, (making me) a servant, a server, blessed: protect my desire.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Maître de la permanence, qui as fait durer pour moi ma vie, (me rendant) serviteur, servant, heureux : protège mon désir.

bayts.text: إِلَيْكَ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِى دَاعِيًا مَّلِكِى ۞ فَلِى اسْتَجِبْ كَرَمًا يَارَبِّ دَعْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te ho rivolto il mio volto, invocandoTi, o mio Re: esaudisci dunque, per generosità, o Signore, la mia invocazione.
translations.en.karamati: To You I have turned my face, calling on You, O my King: so answer, out of generosity, O Lord, my supplication.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Toi j'ai tourné mon visage, T'invoquant, ô mon Roi : exauce donc, par générosité, ô Seigneur, mon invocation.

bayts.text: نَجَّيْتَنِى فَلْتَزِدْنِى رَبِّ تَنْجِيَةً ۞ وَلْتَحْمِنِى وَاحْمِ مَا يَحْوِيهِ مَثْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai salvato: accrescimi dunque, Signore, la salvezza; proteggimi e proteggi ciò che contiene la mia dimora.
translations.en.karamati: You have saved me: so increase me, Lord, in salvation; protect me and protect what my dwelling holds.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as sauvé : accrois-moi donc, Seigneur, le salut ; protège-moi et protège ce que contient ma demeure.

bayts.text: نَجَّيْتَنِى أَمْسِ مِنْ عَوْدِى إِلَى سِلَعٍ ۞ فَالْيَوْمَ كُنْ لِى وَعَظِّمْ مِّنْكَ جَدْوَايَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai salvato ieri dal mio ritorno alle mercanzie (del mondo): oggi dunque sii per me e rendi grande da parte Tua il mio beneficio.
translations.en.karamati: You saved me yesterday from my return to (worldly) merchandise: so today be for me and make great from You my benefit.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as sauvé hier de mon retour aux marchandises (du monde) : aujourd'hui donc sois pour moi et rends grand de Ta part mon bienfait.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى أَبْغِى حِمَايَتَهُ ۞ فَكُنْ حَفِيظِى وَزِدْ يَارَبِّ تَقْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ) di cui cerco la protezione: sii dunque mio Custode e accresci, o Signore, il mio timor di Dio.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ) Whose protection I seek: so be my Preserver and increase, O Lord, my God-fearing.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ) dont je recherche la protection : sois donc mon Gardien et accrois, ô Seigneur, ma crainte de Dieu.

bayts.text: لَكَ انْصِرَا فِىَ كَسْبًا قُدْزِمَامِىَ يَا ۞ رَبِّ وَهَبْ لِىَ حَمْدًا رَّبِّ مَسْرَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te è il mio volgermi come guadagno: conduci le mie redini, o Signore, e donami lode, Signore, del mio viaggio notturno.
translations.en.karamati: To You is my turning as gain: lead my reins, O Lord, and grant me praise, Lord, for my night journey.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi est mon retour comme gain : conduis mes rênes, ô Seigneur, et accorde-moi louange, Seigneur, de mon voyage nocturne.

bayts.text: لَكَارْتِحَا لِىَ ذَا جَرْىٍ فَسُقْ غَرَضِى ۞ لِىَ عَاجِلًا ءَآئِبًا وَلْتَحْمِ مَجْرَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te è la mia partenza, ora in corso: conduci a me presto il mio scopo, (facendomi) ritornare, e proteggi il mio cammino.
translations.en.karamati: To You is my departure, now under way: lead my aim to me soon, (bringing me) back, and protect my course.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi est mon départ, désormais en cours : amène-moi bientôt mon but, (me faisant) revenir, et protège mon cheminement.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى بِكَوْنِكَ وَهَّابَا بِلَا سَبَبٍ ۞ مَّا فَاقَ ظَنِّىَ وَمْلَا رَبِّ مَهْدَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Donami, per il Tuo essere il Donatore (Al-Wahhāb) senza causa, ciò che supera la mia attesa, e riempi, Signore, il mio giaciglio.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me, by Your being the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb) without cause, what surpasses my expectation, and fill, Lord, my resting-place.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi, par Ton être le Donateur (Al-Wahhāb) sans cause, ce qui dépasse mon attente, et remplis, Seigneur, ma couche.

bayts.text: قُدْ ذَا بِلُطْقٍ وَجُودٍ وَاكْفِنِى زَلَلًا ۞ لَّكَ انْتِهَاءِى إِلَاهِى مِنْكَ مَبْدَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Conduci ciò con benevolenza e generosità, e preservami dai passi falsi: a Te è il mio termine, mio Dio, da Te il mio principio.
translations.en.karamati: Lead this with kindness and generosity, and spare me slips: to You is my end, my God, from You my beginning.
translations.fr.karamati: Conduis cela avec bienveillance et générosité, et préserve-moi des faux pas : à Toi est mon terme, mon Dieu, de Toi mon commencement.

bayts.text: وَجَّهْتُ فِى السَّبْتِ وَجْهِى لَكَ فِى رَجَبٍ ۞ وَفِى الثُّلَاثَاءِ فِى شَعْبَانَ مَلْجَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto il mio volto a Te di sabato, in Rajab, e di martedì, in Shaʿbān, (verso) il mio rifugio.
translations.en.karamati: I turned my face to You on a Saturday, in Rajab, and on a Tuesday, in Shaʿbān, (toward) my refuge.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tourné mon visage vers Toi un samedi, en Rajab, et un mardi, en Shaʿbān, (vers) mon refuge.

bayts.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى سَنَدِى ۞ مُحَمَّدٍ وَبِهِ قُدْنِى لِأَرْجَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: O Signore, benedici con il saluto di pace il mio sostegno, Muḥammad, e per mezzo di lui conducimi alle mie speranze.
translations.en.karamati: O Lord, bless with peace my support, Muḥammad, and through him lead me to my hopes.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Seigneur, bénis avec le salut de paix mon appui, Muḥammad, et par lui conduis-moi vers mes espérances.

bayts.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَيْهِ بِلَا ۞ عَدٍّ مَّعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مَنْجَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: O Signore, benedicilo con il saluto di pace senza numero, con la Famiglia e i Compagni, mia salvezza.
translations.en.karamati: O Lord, bless him with peace beyond number, with the Family and the Companions, my salvation.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Seigneur, bénis-le avec le salut de paix sans nombre, avec la Famille et les Compagnons, mon salut.

bayts.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ بِالْجَمِيعِ وَكُنْ ۞ مُّنَوِّرًا بِىَ أَزْمَانِى وَأَنْجَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Su di lui effondi benedizione e pace, insieme a tutti, e sii Colui che per mezzo mio illumina i miei tempi e i miei luoghi di salvezza.
translations.en.karamati: Upon him pour blessing and peace, with all, and be the One Who through me illumines my times and my places of safety.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur lui répands bénédiction et paix, avec tous, et sois Celui qui par moi illumine mes temps et mes lieux de salut.

bayts.text: زِدْنِى عُلُومًا بِكَشْقٍ لَّا يُفَارِقُنِى ۞ يَامَنْ لَّهُ أَشْتَكِى وَلْتُشْكِ شَكْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: Accrescimi in scienze con un disvelamento che non mi abbandoni, o Tu al Quale mi lamento: togli la causa del mio lamento.
translations.en.karamati: Increase me in sciences with an unveiling that never leaves me, O You to Whom I complain: remove the cause of my complaint.
translations.fr.karamati: Accrois-moi en sciences par un dévoilement qui ne me quitte pas, ô Toi auprès de Qui je me plains : ôte la cause de ma plainte.

bayts.text: يَاخَيْرَ مُغْنٍ قَضَا حَاجِى بِلَا كُلَفٍ ۞ يَامَنْ بِكَوْنِكَ لِى فَارَقْتُ بَلْوَا يَا

translations.it.karamati: O migliore Arricchitore, che hai soddisfatto i miei bisogni senza oneri, o Tu per il cui essere per me mi sono separato dalla mia prova.
translations.en.karamati: O best Enricher, Who fulfilled my needs without burdens, O You through Whose being for me I parted from my trial.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô meilleur Enrichisseur, qui as satisfait mes besoins sans charges, ô Toi par l'être de Qui pour moi je me suis séparé de mon épreuve.

bayts.text: زِنْتُ الْقَصَاءِدَ فِيْكُمْ شَاكِرًا لَّكُمُ ۞ بِهَا بِكُمْ وَاجَهُواْ لِى الْكَشْفَ وَالْئَايَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho adornato i poemi per voi, ringraziandovi: per mezzo di essi e per mezzo vostro mi hanno recato il disvelamento e i segni.
translations.en.karamati: I have adorned the poems for you, thanking you: through them and through you they brought me unveiling and signs.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai orné les poèmes pour vous, en vous remerciant : par eux et par vous ils m'ont apporté le dévoilement et les signes.
